link.unlinkDescription: <app>{name}</app> will no longer appear as this app’s linked listing. Keywords and rankings are unaffected.
link.linkDescription: Pair this app with its {store} listing to switch between them from the header.
link.noCandidates: No unlinked {store} apps to link. Import one first.

notices.notInSearchBody: This app is not available on iPhone, and AsoBeast reads iPhone search, so its keywords are never found within the checked depth and its visibility stays at 0.

refresh.staleReason: No keywords are tracked in {market} any more, so its listing is no longer refreshed.

delisted.title: No longer listed on {store}
delisted.since: Since {date}, {store} answers that it has no app {id} in {country}.
delisted.history: The stored history stays, and every daily run checks again, so this notice clears on the first capture that finds the app.
delisted.checkStore: Open the store page to check. If the app moved to a new store id, import it again from its new link.
delisted.goneApp: If it is gone for good, delete it from the dashboard.
delisted.goneCompetitor: If it is gone for good, remove it from the competitors of the app that tracks it.

snapshot.changed: {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} changed since the last snapshot.
snapshot.unchanged: The store listing is unchanged since the last snapshot.
snapshot.caption: Store listing fields that changed since the last snapshot, with before and after values.
